content: This resource tells to gain intuition for the behavior of DC circuits with both resistors and capacitors or inductors. In this particular problem solving you will be working with an RC circuit. You should carefully consider what would change if the capacitor were replaced with an inductor and to calculate the time dependent currents in such circuits.
